rules.required_validation: Selected nonnegative signed finite source integer converts directly to fp32; exact native rounding, sign, overflow and subnormal policy.
Unsigned finite source integer or normalized bool i1 converts directly to fp32; exact native conversion policy.
Native fp32 zero literal and/or integer-zero conversion is represented by M.literal none fp32 0.
Native fp16 positive zero, including integer-zero comparison operand and selected false branch.
Native bf16 positive zero in selected false branch.
cmp16 zero x is native ordered x>=+0 in fp16, including NaN false and both signed zeros true.
cmp32 zero x is native ordered x>=+0 in fp32, including NaN false and both signed zeros true.
M.cast none fp16 fp32 agrees with native extension, including specials and denormal behavior.
M.cast none bf16 fp32 agrees with native extension at both comparison and output ports, including specials.
Concrete sign/exponent/fraction word comparison agrees with native ordered fp64 x>=+0 for every input word.
Both source zero operands materialize as the exact fp64 positive-zero word.
narrow64to32 agrees with native fp64 to fp32 conversion, including ties, overflow, underflow, signed zero, infinities and NaNs.
